intro: Tranquil brings comfort home. With spacious seating, smart storage, and a sleek modern look, Tranquil transforms from a cosy sofa to a comfy bed—whenever you need it.

features.title: Room for everyone
features.text: Designed for gatherings, the wide, L-shaped seating gives your whole family a place to relax, connect, and unwind together.

features.title: Touchably soft fabric
features.text: Wrapped in high-quality fabric, Tranquil offers both elegance and comfort—inviting you to sink in and stay awhile.

features.title: Sofa by day, bed by night
features.text: A smooth, easy conversion turns this sofa into a bed—ideal for guests, naps, or movie marathons that go late.

features.title: Smart armrest storage
features.text: With built-in side pockets, your remotes, books, or magazines stay right where you need them—tidy and accessible.

features.title: Style that fits in
features.text: Its clean lines and neutral brown tone complement everything from minimal to cozy-chic interiors with ease.

features.title: Stay charged, stay cozy
features.text: Integrated charging ports let you power your devices without leaving the comfort of your seat—modern convenience built in.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
